name: Community — MiniMax H3 (Turbo, Fully Accelerated)
author: larryvrh + kijai + xmarre
description: MiniMax H3 text-to-video with every acceleration technique stacked: MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA (v4-600 EMA, applied via the dedicated ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo loader - required on our pruned int8 base, since a generic LoRA loader silently drops the adaln timing-curve weights) + MiniMax H3 Turbo Sampler (dual-schedule aware, auto-detects native ModelSamplingAV) + SageAttention (KJNodes) + MiniMax H3 Sigma Shift (native noise-schedule control) + Spectrum (xmarre's spectral-feature-forecasting accelerator, ~30-40% fewer transformer evaluations) + Sol-Attn (sparse attention, reduced VRAM). Stack order and recommended settings sourced from the community workflow this pack is based on. Steps reduced from the official 20 down to 10 (can go as low as 4 per the source video, at a quality cost). Tested T2V at 5s/480p/10 steps: 99.1s total, LoRA log-confirmed fully applied (208/208 backbone modules + 51 adaln modules, zero dropped keys) - clean video output across sampled frames, no artifacts, no visible plastic-skin/over-sharp-grain look. Research/experimental preset - Spectrum in particular is an approximate accelerator (not bit-identical output) with documented audio-fidelity tradeoffs the author addressed via offline_smoothing_replay in v0.2.1+; using its documented safe defaults here (blend_weight 0.50, audio_blend_weight 0.00, offline_smoothing_replay on).

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Text to Video (Turbo, Fully Accelerated)
presets.description: Describe a scene and get video with matching stereo sound. Stacks Turbo LoRA + SageAttention + Sigma Shift + Spectrum + Sol-Attn for the fastest MiniMax H3 preset in this repo. Research/experimental - Spectrum's forecasted steps change the denoising trajectory, so output isn't bit-identical to unaccelerated MiniMax H3. Needs four custom nodes.

video.displayModel: MiniMax H3 (pruned int8) + Turbo LoRA + SageAttention + Sigma Shift + Spectrum + Sol-Attn

extensions.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
extensions.description: Turbo LoRA loader node + dual-schedule sampler node (required - the workflow will fail to load without it)

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ - this workflow applies SageAttention itself, via this node. IMPORTANT: do not stack a second model-level SageAttention patch on top of it. If your setup applies SageAttention globally (ComfyUI's --use-sage-attention, or a host app that patches the model for you), the two patches together can make Turbo output numerically invalid - reported as black or garbage frames. On SimpliGen this is handled automatically: the app withholds its own per-preset patch for this preset, so this node is the only one active.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3
extensions.description: Spectral-feature-forecasting accelerator for native MiniMax H3 (SpectrumApplyMiniMaxH3 node). NOT pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton
extensions.description: Sol-Attn sparse-attention node (Triton kernels). NOT pre-installed by SimpliGen. Requires the engine's Python to have dev headers (Python.h / python3XX.lib) for Triton's JIT compiler - present from SimpliGen 1.43.x onward. REQUIRES SimpliGen Settings > Advanced > 'Faster Attention' to be ON - that toggle controls whether the triton-windows pip package stays installed, and without it this node fails to import ('No module named triton'). SimpliGen's own 'Repair now' prompt will NOT fix this. Note that toggle does two distinct things: globally it installs/removes the triton + sageattention packages (needed here), while per-preset it decides whether SimpliGen applies its own SageAttention patch (withheld for this preset, which is what we want - see the KJNodes note on double-patching). Leaving it ON is correct for this preset: the packages stay installed and SimpliGen still withholds the duplicate patch.

requirements.notes: Same base weights as SimpliGen's official MiniMax H3 pack (pruned int8 + nvfp4 encoder) plus the ~744MB Turbo LoRA - no new downloads beyond that. Needs FOUR custom nodes: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo (LoRA loader + dual-schedule sampler - required on this pruned base, a generic LoRA loader silently drops the adaln timing-curve weights), ComfyUI-KJNodes, ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3, and ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton (Sol-Attn also needs SimpliGen 1.43.x+ and Faster Attention enabled - see the extension note). Directly measured by this repo's maintainer: 5s/480p/10 steps in 99.1s, with the LoRA log-confirmed fully applied (zero dropped keys). Recommend 10 steps for quality; can go as low as 4 for speed per the source video, at a real quality cost.
